class.name: LoadProgress
class.brief_description: Snapshot of the progress of loading a set of files.

method.name: get_loaded_count
method.description: Returns the number of files that are loaded (or failed to load, which is also done).

method.name: get_ratio
method.description: Returns the progress from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Where the loader reports it, files that are still loading count with their own progress, so the value moves between two loaded files. It is [code]1.0[/code] when there is nothing to load.

method.name: get_total_count
method.description: Returns the number of files to load.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if every file is loaded ([method get_loaded_count] is not less than [method get_total_count]), also if there are no files.
